NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 构建数据中心级AI基础设施，以加速计算平台和CUDA生态赋能各行业AI应用。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Building data-center-scale AI infrastructure with accelerated computing and CUDA ecosystem to power industries.

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 提供全面AI技术栈，注重负责任部署与安全保障，赋能各行业生产力提升。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Offer full-stack AI capabilities, emphasizing responsible deployment, security, and productivity gains across enterprises.
concrete_bets: Intelligent cloud and edge platform with AI capabilities

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.

PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate generative AI via AIP platform into existing operating systems to empower decisions.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 将AI融入应用全家桶与智能眼镜，构建下一代计算平台。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate AI across apps and wearables to build next-gen computing platform.
